summary: A dwelling provides a settled place for its occupant. The psalmist applies the word to the sanctuary and also calls Yahweh himself the dwelling of his people.

senses.definition: Jerusalem’s ruins become a dwelling for jackals. The psalmist speaks of loving the habitation of Yahweh’s house.
The psalm addresses God as the abiding dwelling of his people throughout the generations.
Lions lie down in their dens when the sun rises. The blessing of Moses calls the everlasting God a place of refuge.

note: The verb “dwell” is inferred. Forms such as וַיַּעַן in Genesis 18:27 are from ענה, “answer”. Maon also names a town and surrounding wilderness (Joshua 15:55; 1 Samuel 23:24). The shared index key is assigned to the personal name. The reading at Isaiah 11:15 supplies no clear dwelling term.
